title: Potential cash-flow collision
summary: You may be short on cash for your rent payment on Sept 4th.
explanation: A freelance payment you were expecting was delayed, cutting projected income and widening uncertainty. Your rent is due in a few days and your checking balance has dropped sharply. Shortfall probability has risen significantly.

suggested_actions.description: Transfer funds from your Emergency Fund to Checking to cover the rent gap.
Pause discretionary spending until the freelance payment clears.
